## Koko v1.0.2

### Fixes

- **Re-navigate crash (`Transport closed`)**: gate reentrant CDP during `commitPendingPage` / `initiateRootNavigation`
- **V8 `IsOnCentralStack` fatal on heavy sites (Wikipedia)**: defer nested `setTimeout` timer pump except on fingerprint.com probes
- **Profile bootstrap UAF**: stop freeing cached browser install root in `ProfileSnapshot`

### Upgrade

```bash
brew update && brew upgrade koko
```
